menu.title: MAIN MENU
menu.scan.description: Inspects your PC without changing anything and reports what needs your attention.
menu.maintenance.description: Pick a category and then the exact action to run. Nothing runs unless you choose it.
menu.settings.description: Change how Caduceus behaves. Your choices are saved for the next time.
maintenance.title: MANUAL MAINTENANCE
maintenance.cleanup.description: Frees up disk space by removing leftovers such as temporary files and the contents of the Recycle Bin.
cleanup.title: PC CLEANUP
cleanup.temp_files.description: Deletes the contents of your %TEMP% folder and of C:\Windows\Temp (only what is older than an hour) and the .pf files in C:\Windows\Prefetch. Windows rebuilds Prefetch, so the first launch of each program may be slightly slower. Files in use are skipped.
cleanup.hidden_junk.description: Deletes the thumbnail and icon caches of the Explorer, the Windows error reports (WER), the crash dumps (%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps) and the memory dumps (C:\Windows\Minidump, LiveKernelReports and MEMORY.DMP). Folders with pictures may open slower once and icons may redraw while they are rebuilt. Past crash reports are lost.
cleanup.caches.description: Deletes the Windows Update download cache (C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download), the Delivery Optimization cache, the shader caches of DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD, the caches of Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox (every profile) and of Discord, Slack, VS Code and Steam. Cookies, passwords and history are never touched. Pages and apps load slower the first time, games may stutter a little while shaders are rebuilt, and a pending update is downloaded again. Close the browsers first to free more.
cleanup.components.description: Runs the official Windows command (DISM /StartComponentCleanup) to remove components left by old updates from C:\Windows\WinSxS. It takes minutes, cannot be cancelled once started and may ask for a restart. You can still uninstall updates. The gain is not estimated.
cleanup.windows_old.description: Deletes the previous Windows installation (C:\Windows.old) with the Windows Disk Cleanup. It can free many GB, but you can no longer go back to the previous version of Windows. It asks for confirmation first and cannot be cancelled once started. Only available with Safe mode OFF.
cleanup.windows_old.confirm: This permanently deletes the previous Windows installation (C:\Windows.old). You will no longer be able to go back to the previous version of Windows, and this cannot be undone. Once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
cleanup.all.description: Runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other, and shows the result of each. It always asks for confirmation, even with Safe mode ON (which skips the actions it blocks). Cannot be cancelled once started and can take several minutes. All the consequences above apply.
cleanup.all.confirm:
This runs every cleanup in the list, one after the other.
Once it starts it CANNOT be cancelled, and it can take several minutes.
The Recycle Bin is emptied for good: deleted items cannot be restored.
With Safe mode OFF, Windows.old is deleted too and you can no longer go back to the previous version of Windows.
Parts of it need administrator.
cleanup.recycle_bin.description: Permanently deletes everything in the Recycle Bin of every fixed drive (C:\, D:\, ...). Deleted items cannot be restored afterwards.
cleanup.recycle_bin.confirm: This permanently deletes everything in the Recycle Bin of every fixed drive. Deleted items cannot be restored, and once it starts it cannot be cancelled.
components.step: Cleaning the Windows component store (this can take several minutes)
windows_old.step: Deleting Windows.old (this can take several minutes)

settings.safe_mode.description: When ON, blocks the actions that cannot be undone and put the system at risk: for now, deleting Windows.old. Turn it OFF to run them. ON is recommended. Saved between sessions.
